about.description: Single-stock perpetual on Lighter Labs tracking Hanmi Pharm Co., Ltd. (128940.KS), with pricing referencing Lighter fair price oracle (24/5 equity feed). Users gain linear exposure to Hanmi Pharm Co., Ltd. share-price moves without owning shares, shareholder rights, or dividend claims. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDC on Lighter ZK-rollup (Ethereum).
